resolutions.split: Ledger file repaired by the orchestrator in 33dbf42. The implementer's half was the false claim in tasks/reviews/pr69-r1-resolution.json's rebase_note.
resolutions.note: The note swore two things that were both false — 'zero rows present in origin/main are missing from the branch' and that a literal ts-dedup 'would have destroyed one of each, and did not'. Corrected in place, with the original wording restated rather than edited out, all 11 lost ts named, and the collateral spelled out: 20260822-174202 is the row T-M39-15-D3 cites as 'the single exception' in its own arithmetic, so the PR had deleted evidence its own debt block depends on.
resolutions.root_cause_of_the_false_claim: The original verification compared SETS of row bodies. A set comparison cannot see a multiplicity dropping from 2 to 1, so it reported 0 missing while 11 rows were gone. Re-verified with a MULTISET comparison: 2192 rows on origin/main, 0 missing by multiplicity, 20260822-174202 present twice again. Worth recording because it is the id-collision class this whole PR exists for, one level down — a duplicate that is invisible to the check looking at it.

resolutions.covered_by: task-id-parse-boundary fixture 6 (new) — an unbalanced fence: a prose line that merely BEGINS with ``` sitting above a later real block, with a genuine duplicate id between them
resolutions.watched_red: evals/report/20260828-045259-invariant.json, before the fix: {'fixture': 'UNBALANCED fence...', 'want': {'duplicate_todo_ids': ['M50']}, 'got': {}} — the silent false negative exactly.
resolutions.regression_owned: This was introduced by the implementer's own R2 fix in round 1, and it is strictly worse than the defect it replaced: R2's bug was a false POSITIVE, which is loud, and this was a false NEGATIVE, which is silent. Measured on the live tree before the fix: appending a genuinely duplicated `### T-M39-7` block containing an ordinary ```bash fence made the probe report [] while swallowing 110 headings.
resolutions.fix: _FENCE now requires a delimiter to be a WHOLE line — ``` plus an optional info word and nothing else — so tasks/TODO.md's single literal-\n prose line is not an opener and cannot pair with a real block below it. Verified after: 198 headings raw, 198 after stripping, 0 lost, and the reviewer's own repro now reports duplicate_todo_ids ['T-M39-7'].
resolutions.deliberate_simplification: A full-line match, not a fence state machine. Unbalanced delimiters now fail to pair and strip nothing, which is the safe direction — the worst case becomes a loud false red rather than a silent miss. Recorded as a ponytail comment naming the upgrade trigger: nested fences or ~~~ delimiters, neither of which this repo uses.
